inspection.scope: Main singlet model definition in section 1 and bounded complex-singlet generalization in section 6.4. Other extensions are deferred; not a whole-paper reread.

claims.locator: atlas/FIELD_CONTENT_CONVENTIONS.md, explicit F_SM/R_SM/R_MSSM templates; source model-definition locator below
claims.value: Expand the expressly inherited SM/MSSM with its standard three families and exact representations. Dynkin maps: su(3) 3=[1,0], anti-3=[0,1], adjoint=[1,1]; su(2) d has label [d-1]. All Weyl fields are LH, including u^c,d^c,e^c. Ordinary textbook Y is used only as the declared baseline coordinate, not claimed to be individually tabulated by this source. No right-handed neutrino or additional sector is invented.

claims.locator: Section 1, PDF/printed p.1 Eqs.(1)-(2) and paragraphs below; section 6.4, PDF/printed p.12 contrasting complex and real singlet model
claims.value: Main model is SM plus one real scalar singlet S with Z2 stability. Eq.(1) only displays phenomenologically relevant mass/portal terms; surrounding text explicitly mentions the kinetic and quartic self-coupling, so the omitted S^4 in Eq.(1) is not evidence that the interaction is absent.

claims.locator: P01 Eq.(2.1), PDF p.5; P02 Eq.(1), PDF p.1
claims.value: P01 writes lambda S^2 H^dagger H, P02 writes (lambda_hS/2) S^2 |H|^2. Thus lambda_hS=2 lambda for the same canonically normalized real S. These are not different gauge/matter content.

claims.locator: Section 6.4, PDF/printed p.12 Eq.(26) and immediately surrounding paragraphs
claims.value: Bounded generalization is one complex gauge singlet with no extra gauge interactions. Source explicitly writes S=(S1+iS2)/sqrt(2), identifies S1,S2 as canonically normalized real singlets, and states the equivalence to two real singlets. Later extra X and dark-radiation possibilities are not part of this bounded candidate.

Reuse real-singlet-z2 for the main P01/P02 field content; reuse complex-singlet-portal for section 6.4 under current complex-scalar convention. Do not add another row for the alternative two-real description; current checker lacks that realification quotient, so the explicit source equivalence is retained separately.

claims.locator: singlet and complex-singlet source candidates/preflight reports; declared F_SM/R_SM baseline
claims.value: One shared scale 6 over inherited textbook Y yields primitive integer hypercharges. Both candidate singlet sectors have zero hypercharge. P02 does not newly tabulate the full inherited SM charges; these are the explicit baseline coordinate.
